meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
For oily skin in India, buy **Cetaphil Oily Skin Cleanser**—the best all-round choice under ₹500. It is a gentle, foaming, pH-balanced cleanser designed to remove excess oil without leaving skin overly dry; listings show it around ₹220–₹323 depending on size and seller.[1][3][7]

### Good alternatives

- **The Derma Co 2% Sali-Cinamide Face Wash** — best if you also have pimples, blackheads, or clogged pores; listed around ₹415.[10]
- **Dot & Key Cica 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash** — another acne-prone-skin option, with a two-pack listed around ₹348.[7]
- **Himalaya Purifying Neem Face Wash** — budget option for basic cleansing, listed around ₹172.[10]
- **NIVEA Men Oil Control Face Wash** — suitable if you want a stronger oil-control cleanser; it advertises up to 12-hour oil control.[1]

Use face wash **twice daily at most**, and choose Cetaphil instead of a strong salicylic-acid cleanser if your skin is sensitive or easily irritated.[9] Prices fluctuate, so check the final price and seller before ordering.
